---
title: "NAIA Women's Wrestling National Championships"
subtitle: "2026 Team Standings & Individual Weight Class Brackets"
---

Interactive results from the 2026 NAIA Women's Wrestling National Championships. Use the tabs below to view team standings or explore individual weight classes. Click any wrestler's row to view their individual match results.


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

# Read the match data and team scores
matches <- read_csv("data/trackwrestling_matches.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
team_scores <- read_csv("data/trackwrestling_team_scores.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
all_matches <- read_csv("data/naia_matches_all_years.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Color badge helpers for match methods and results
badge_win_method <- \(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == "") return("")
  val <- tolower(as.character(value))
  col <- if (grepl("fall|vfa", val)) "#dc2626" else if (grepl("tf|tech|vsu", val)) "#7c3aed" else if (grepl("dec|vpo", val)) "#2563eb" else "#64748b"
  tags$span(
    style = sprintf("display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; background: %s18; color: %s;", col, col),
    value
  )
}

badge_result <- \(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == "") return("")
  col <- if (value == "Won") "#16a34a" else "#dc2626"
  tags$span(
    style = sprintf("display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; background: %s18; color: %s;", col, col),
    value
  )
}

# Clean, modern theme for all tables
tbl_theme <- reactableTheme(
  borderColor = "#e2e8f0",
  stripedColor = "#f8fafc",
  highlightColor = "#eff6ff",
  cellPadding = "8px 12px",
  headerStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#f8fafc",
    borderBottom = "2px solid #cbd5e1",
    fontWeight = 600,
    fontSize = "0.875rem",
    color = "#334155"
  )
)

# Combine wins and losses so each wrestler has their full match log
wrestler_matches <- bind_rows(
  matches |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = winner, school = winner_school, result = "Won", opponent = paste0(loser, " (", loser_school, ")"), round, score),
  matches |> transmute(weight_class, wrestler = loser, school = loser_school, result = "Lost", opponent = paste0(winner, " (", winner_school, ")"), round, score)
)

# Function to build an interactive table for any weight class
make_weight_table <- \(wt) {
  summary_df <- wrestler_matches |>
    filter(weight_class == wt) |>
    group_by(wrestler, school) |>
    summarize(
      wins = sum(result == "Won"),
      losses = sum(result == "Lost"),
      record = paste0(wins, "-", losses),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(wins), losses) |>
    select(wrestler, school, record)

  reactable(
    summary_df,
    theme = tbl_theme,
    searchable = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    bordered = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      wrestler = colDef(name = "Wrestler"),
      school = colDef(name = "School"),
      record = colDef(name = "Record (W-L)", align = "center")
    ),
    details = \(index) {
      w_name <- summary_df$wrestler[index]
      sub_matches <- wrestler_matches |>
        filter(weight_class == wt, wrestler == w_name) |>
        select(round, opponent, result, score)
      reactable(
        sub_matches,
        theme = tbl_theme,
        outlined = TRUE,
        striped = TRUE,
        columns = list(
          round = colDef(name = "Round"),
          opponent = colDef(name = "Opponent"),
          result = colDef(name = "Result", width = 85, align = "center", cell = badge_result),
          score = colDef(name = "Score")
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
```

## Team Standings

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4.5
team_scores |>
  slice_max(score, n = 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = reorder(team, score))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2563eb", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = score), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#1e293b") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Team Finishes",
    subtitle = "Total team points at the 2026 National Championship",
    caption = "Source: TrackWrestling",
    x = "Team Points",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
reactable(
  team_scores |> select(place, team, score),
  theme = tbl_theme,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10,
  columns = list(
    place = colDef(name = "Place", width = 75, align = "center"),
    team = colDef(name = "Team"),
    score = colDef(name = "Points", width = 95, align = "right")
  ),
  searchable = TRUE
)
```

## All-Time Matches (2019–2026)

```{r}
#| echo: false
reactable(
  all_matches,
  theme = tbl_theme,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50, 100),
  columns = list(
    year = colDef(name = "Year", width = 80, align = "center"),
    weight_class = colDef(name = "Weight", width = 85, align = "center"),
    round = colDef(name = "Round", minWidth = 130),
    winner = colDef(name = "Winner", minWidth = 140),
    winner_school = colDef(name = "Winner School", minWidth = 140),
    win_method = colDef(name = "Method", width = 110, align = "center", cell = badge_win_method),
    score = colDef(name = "Score / Time", minWidth = 100),
    loser = colDef(name = "Loser", minWidth = 140),
    loser_school = colDef(name = "Loser School", minWidth = 140)
  )
)
```
